caseName: Healy, Chief of Police, v. Ratta
caseNameFull: Michael J. Healy, Chief of Police of the City of Manchester, New Hampshire v. Louis D. Ratta
attorneys: Mr. H. Thornton Lorimer, Assistant Attorney General of New Hampshire, with whom Mr. Francis W. Johnston, Attorney General, was on the brief, for appellant. Messrs. William N.' Rogers and Jonathan Piper filed a brief for appellee.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the District Court of the United States, for the District of New Hampshire.

In this case probable jurisdiction is noted; The Court desires to hear argument upon the questions.: (a) whether a case for equitable relief is shown; (b) whether the amount in controversy is such as to sustain the jurisdiction of the court below; and (c) whether the defendant-appellant is á state bfficer within the meaning of § 266, Judicial Code, as amended (43 Stat. 936, 938; U. S. Code, Title 28, § 380).
